summary: Seattle, computer programmer, Caltech graduate, D programming language enthusiast, compiler design, mechanical engineering background, enjoys building and working on hotrods (specifically a '72 Dodge Challenger), strong belief in free market principles, values organized thinking and problem-solving skills, advocates for education reform, has a family structure that includes a father who served in WWII and attended MIT, enjoys reading and digitizing old books, has a strong interest in aviation history, particularly the Wright brothers, and has a critical view of government regulation in various industries.
